tools.name: check_domain_setup
tools.description: Check whether a domain is set up to send and receive email: MX records, SPF, DMARC, the detected mail provider, and a graded report with a recommendation. Reads public DNS only. Works with no account and no API key, so use it freely to diagnose a domain before suggesting anyone sign up.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_domain_setup · Private data: check_domain_setup · Public sink: check_domain_setup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_domain_setup · Private data: check_domain_setup · Public sink: check_domain_setup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
